text: 标普500指数的11个板块普遍收跌，日用消费品、保健、工业、房地产、金融板块跌1.68%-1.19%，电信、能源板块至多跌0.04%，可选消费板块涨0.13%，信息技术/科技板块涨0.61%。
text_en: All 11 sectors of the S&P 500 closed lower broadly, with consumer staples, health care, industrials, real estate and financials down 1.68%-1.19%, telecom and energy down at most 0.04%, consumer discretionary up 0.13%, and information technology/tech up 0.61%.
